=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=
 Mr. R.L. Kadu, Advocate for the Petitioner.
 Mrs. Nandita Tripathi, A.P.P. for the Respondents.
 Coram : Anil L. Pansare & Nivedita P. Meh
Date : 24th March, 2026.
The petitioner is seeking premature release.
He has been convicted for the offence punishable under Section 376(2) of the Indian Penal Code.

02. The learned A.P.P. submits that the benefit of remission cannot be extended in terms of the order dated 23/07/2015 passed by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Writ Petition (Criminal)
No.48/2014.
03.
The petitioner shall go through the said order and make submissions on the next date.

04. List the matter on 2nd April, 2026.
(Nivedita P. Mehta, J.) (Anil L. Pansare, J.) *sandesh
